803-5913-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-5913-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-4247-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4247-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

401-1385-2530-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-1385-2530-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

2103-2707-6005.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

5254-6774-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6774-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

1818-5010-6900-8095.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-5010-6900-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5332-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-4716.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-3446-5131-6798--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3446-5131-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

4153-5641-6258.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

4365-4772-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1512-3525-4474.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {U}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

5636-5742-5743-7824.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6791-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4890-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4890-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dack's Duplicate and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4890-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1879-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1879-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1879-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

804-847-1459-1636.description:
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have Sakashima the Impostor enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters, Intruder Alarm and Galadriel trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Activate Gilraen by paying {2} and tapping it, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Intruder Alarm and Sakashima the Impostor trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} and untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
804-847-1459-1636.notes: Once you have extra mana, you can choose the other modes of Galadriel. You can also blink other creatures using Gilraen.

618-4456-7494-7650.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Bilbo.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

4381-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

2178-3967-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-7060-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

539-4657-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

2281-4050-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-4050-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-2820-3175.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5007-5231-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2173-3558-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

372-1031-1922.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1031-1922.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian and causing you to draw a card.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

5641-6823-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6823-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

469-1357-4697.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
469-1357-4697.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Holding priority, cast Insidious Will by paying its mana cost, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
469-1357-4697.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

1245-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures
1245-6441.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat.

997-2018--73.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-2018--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

2523-2921-5558.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Enraged Huorn.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1972-4179-5280.manaNeeded: {6}{G}{G}{U}{U} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {8}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} otherwise
1972-4179-5280.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Nekusar triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 3.

717-4798-5437-5686.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

573-654-774.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4249-4954.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eleven devotion to any color.
4249-4954.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to add eleven mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {8}, causing Nykthos to become an 8/8 Elemental with haste until end of turn, and untapping it.
Repeat.

4289-4824-4944.notablePrerequisites: Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
4289-4824-4944.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Soliton ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2104-3229-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
2104-3229-4423.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library.
Activate Kefnet the Mindful by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
